title: Earth's 2024 Day Was 1.66 Milliseconds Shorter
hook: Earth erased 1.66 milliseconds from a 2024 day.
closing: Tiny changes could force clocks to subtract time for the first time.
question: Would you notice a shorter day?

segments.say: A 2024 day ran 1.66 milliseconds short, setting the latest speed record.
Since 1972, clocks added 27 leap seconds and removed none.
By 2035, a negative leap second has a 40% chance of becoming necessary.
